d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.

d40: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. d40: What Jamal kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.

d40: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.

d40: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Stalk (Level 1). Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
